_note: USD per 1M tokens, from OpenAI's pricing page (checked 2026-10-25). Must match input_cost/output_cost in kong/kong.yaml. The test set refers to TIERS, not model names, so a model swap only changes this file and kong.yaml.

brief_models._note: Models named in the use-case brief. o4-mini was shut down by OpenAI on 2026-10-23; mistral-tiny is a legacy Mistral alias. Kept for traceability only.

embeddings._calls_note: /assistant/chat embeds the prompt up to 3x: semantic prompt guard, semantic cache, semantic router. The hybrid /assistant/order-status route embeds 0x. Embedding price not shown on OpenAI's pricing page on 2026-10-25 - verify.
